newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rallying on fresh commitment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rallying on fresh commitment.

text.p: Dhaka shares are expected to maintain their rally on Wednesday with retail investors making fresh commitments on a wide range of issues, brokers said.
"The market is most likely to maintain its uptrend. A large number of issues which suffered heavy corrections early in the week are drawing investors," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
On Tuesday the DSE all-share price index closed 51.51 points or 2.93 percent higher at 1,806.20 on a turnover of 95.8 million taka.
